purpose: Assess whether AUD can enter the same reaction-function/transmission research framework used for USD/GBP/CAD/JPY without revised-history substitution or timing shortcuts.

macro_live_source_contract.limitation: current/latest-release candidate contract only; not a certified historical first-release event panel

rba_front_end_history.note: legacy AUD/RBA branches contain current/runtime/pricing probes and payload snapshots, not a clean certified historical front-end series aligned to macro event dates

macro_channels: labour/full-employment gap -> RBA reaction -> front-end rates -> AUD
inflation -> RBA reaction -> front-end rates -> AUD

decision.reason: Cannot test AUD reaction/transmission honestly until historical first-release macro events and a certified historical RBA/front-end series share a common timestamped event universe.
do_not_use: revised macro history as substitute for first-release events
current runtime snapshots as historical front-end history
ASX/RBA pricing probes as if they were a certified continuous historical 2Y/OIS series

next_research_contract.step_1: Materialize ABS first-release unemployment history with publication dates.
next_research_contract.step_2: Materialize ABS first-release CPI history with publication dates; keep quarterly/monthly regime changes explicit rather than backfilling one definition across time.
next_research_contract.step_3: Certify a historical RBA-sensitive front-end series on a fixed basis and timestamp convention.
next_research_contract.step_4: Build frozen dual-mandate AUD macro states without fitted weights.
next_research_contract.step_5: Observe fixed post-release 5-market-day front-end repricing and subsequent signed 20d AUD G8 basket return.
next_research_contract.step_6: Use 40% initial chronology + pooled forward OOS and robustness; no threshold/window tuning.
